question: What bodily form results from constant yogic practice over time?
premises: The practice is constant yogic discipline
A duration of sixteen years is indicated
A specific bodily form is attained
inference: Through constant yogic practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
uncertainties: dvi-aṣṭa-varṣa-ākṛtiḥ is interpreted as the appearance of sixteen years
